NIKITA CHAUDHARY Phone No : 7085920833 | Email : 412nikita@gmail.com Regulatory & Transaction Reporting Analyst | MiFID II | Regulatory Reporting | Derivatives | Client & Stakeholder Management

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Regulatory Reporting professional with 4.5+ years of experience supporting regulatory reporting, reporting analysis, data validation, exception management and stakeholder coordination within financial services. Experienced in MiFID II, Solvency II, PRIIPs, SFDR, MMF and AIFMD reporting processes, with strong exposure to regulatory data quality, reporting issue investigation and timely resolution. Prior experience in Exchange Traded Derivatives and Middle Office Operations, including trade capture, trade controls, trade notifications and exception management. Experienced in coordinating with clients, brokers and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and operational issues.

CORE SKILLS • Regulatory Reporting • Solvency II • SFDR • Regulatory Report Analysis & Validation • Trade & Transaction Data • Trade Capture & Trade Lifecycle • Stakeholder Management • Trade/Position/Cash Controls

MiFID II – Cost & Charges • PRIIPs • MMF & AIFMD Reporting • Reporting Exception / Issue Management • Exchange Traded Derivatives • Client & Query Management • Process Improvement & Automation • Advanced Excel & Reporting

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Regulatory Reporting Associate Ameriprise Financial | Gurugram

Sep 2022 – Apr 2026

Managed end-to-end regulatory reporting activities across MiFID II, Solvency II, PRIIPs, SFDR, MMF and AIFMD







requirements, ensuring accurate, complete and timely reporting. Performed daily and pre-submission validation of regulatory reporting data and outputs to identify missing information, data discrepancies, and reporting exceptions. Supported MiFID II reporting activities, validating underlying transaction/reporting data, and ensuring completeness and accuracy prior to submission. Investigated reporting discrepancies, exceptions and rejected outputs, performed root-cause analysis and coordinated corrective actions through final resolution.

Reviewed regulatory reporting outputs against source data to identify data mismatches, inconsistencies and reporting gaps, working with upstream and downstream teams for remediation.

Managed client-specific regulatory reporting queries and escalations investigated reporting issues and coordinated

resolution with clients, brokers, and internal stakeholders. Provided timely updates on open reporting issues, remediation actions and resolution status, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and closure. Supported UAT and validation of regulatory reporting changes, including test execution, output validation, defect identification, and resolution before production implementation. Supported regulatory change and client-specific reporting initiatives, including impact assessment, requirement analysis, process/control updates, and post-implementation validation. Coordinated with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of reporting queries and delivery of regulatory outputs. Supported quality control checks on regulatory reports before final delivery.







• • Maintained documentation and audit trails for reporting activities to support governance and audit readiness. • Participated in process improvement initiatives aimed at improving reporting accuracy, efficiency and control effectiveness.

Handled client and stakeholder queries related to regulatory reporting data, reporting status, and issue resolution. • Coordinated with clients and internal stakeholders to investigate reporting discrepancies and data-related issues. • Provided timely updates to stakeholders on open reporting issues, corrective actions, and resolution status. • Managed escalated reporting queries by coordinating with relevant teams and ensuring end-to-end follow-up until closure. Supported stakeholder discussions around reporting requirements, data issues, and process changes.

checks, exception investigation and resolution. Investigated reporting discrepancies, exceptions and rejected outputs, performed RCA and coordinated corrective actions through closure.
